descriptions.zh:
本接口支持对指定RuleId的⽔印规则各项参数进⾏更新调整。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为60次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation updates the parameters of a watermark rule based on the specified rule ID.

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 60 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live update-live-stream-watermark-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rule-id 445409ec-7eaa-461d-8f29-4bec2eb90000 --name WatermarkRule0000 --description my_rule --template-id 445409ec-7eaa-461d-8f29-4bec2eb9_0000 --region cn-hangzhou
